scanNote:
PHOTO FILE - UNIT 6 (raqamsiz bet, pdf 150). Qirqib olinadigan karta. Yuqorida to'q sariq 'UNIT 6'.

YaShIL QOG'OZ (qaydlar): • they are full of sugar and are bad for your teeth • they will keep you awake at night • they keep your skin clear • they are bad for your health • it will keep your body healthy. 'Use: a lot of, too much, too many, don't etc'

BESh RASM (✓ yoki ✗ belgili) va har biri ostida bo'sh qatorlar:
1 ✗ pechenye va shokoladlar (cookies, biscuits, chocolates)
2 ✗ pitsa va gamburger (pizza, hamburger)
3 ✓ meva va sabzavotlar (apples, pears, bananas, turnips, parsnips, lettuce)
4 ✓ bir stakan suv (a glass of water)
5 ✗ qahva va choy (coffee, tea)

⚠ Bu 6-unitdagi Writing (Project) uchun shablon - sog'lom ovqatlanish bo'yicha maslahatlar (should/shouldn't, too much/too many).

sections.title: Photo File - Unit 6: Healthy eating advice

exercises.instructionEn: Match the pictures to the notes. Notes: they are full of sugar and are bad for your teeth; they will keep you awake at night; they keep your skin clear; they are bad for your health; it will keep your body healthy.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarni qaydlarga moslang. Qaydlar: ular shakarga to'la va tishingiz uchun zararli; ular sizni kechasi uyg'oq tutadi; ular teringizni toza saqlaydi; ular sog'lig'ingiz uchun zararli; u tanangizni sog'lom saqlaydi.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMLAR va QAYDLAR:

  ✗ pechenye, shokolad → full of
    sugar, bad for your teeth
  ✗ pitsa, gamburger → bad for
    your health
  ✓ meva, sabzavot → keep your
    skin clear
  ✓ suv → it will keep your body
    healthy
  ✗ qahva, choy → keep you awake
    at night

  ⚠ ✓ = yaxshi (should)
  ⚠ ✗ = yomon (shouldn't)


⚠ 'FULL OF SUGAR':

  = shakarga to'la.


⚠ 'TO KEEP YOU AWAKE':

  = uyg'oq tutmoq.


⚠ 'CLEAR SKIN':

  = toza teri.


⚠ 'A TURNIP' / 'A PARSNIP':

  = sholg'om / oq sabzi (rasmda).


⚠ 'LETTUCE':

  = salat bargi.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the notes and the pictures to write advice about healthy eating (Unit 6, Writing Project). Use: a lot of, too much, too many, don't, should, shouldn't etc.
exercises.instructionUz: Qaydlar va rasmlardan foydalanib sog'lom ovqatlanish bo'yicha maslahatlar yozing (6-unit, Yozuv loyihasi). Ishlating: a lot of, too much, too many, don't, should, shouldn't va h.k.
exercises.explanationUz:
MASLAHAT QOLIPLARI:

  ✗ You SHOULDN'T eat TOO MANY
    biscuits (sanaladigan).
  ✗ You SHOULDN'T drink TOO MUCH
    coffee (sanalmaydigan).
  ✗ DON'T eat ...
  ✓ You SHOULD eat A LOT OF fruit.
  ✓ You SHOULD drink A LOT OF
    water.
  + SABAB: because ...


⚠ TOO MUCH / TOO MANY:

  too MANY + sanaladigan ko'plik:
    biscuits, chocolates, hamburgers
  too MUCH + sanalmaydigan:
    sugar, coffee, tea, pizza


⚠ 'A LOT OF':

  ikkalasi bilan ham: a lot of
  fruit, a lot of vegetables.
exercises.exampleEn: You shouldn't eat too many biscuits and chocolates because they are full of sugar and are bad for your teeth.
exercises.exampleUz: Juda ko'p pechenye va shokolad yemasligingiz kerak, chunki ular shakarga to'la va tishingiz uchun zararli.
modelAnswers: Don't eat too much pizza or too many hamburgers because they are bad for your health.
You should eat a lot of fruit and vegetables because they keep your skin clear.
You should drink a lot of water because it will keep your body healthy.
You shouldn't drink too much coffee or tea because they will keep you awake at night.
modelAnswersUz: Juda ko'p pitsa yoki gamburger yemang, chunki ular sog'lig'ingiz uchun zararli.
Ko'p meva va sabzavot yeyishingiz kerak, chunki ular teringizni toza saqlaydi.
Ko'p suv ichishingiz kerak, chunki u tanangizni sog'lom saqlaydi.
Juda ko'p qahva yoki choy ichmasligingiz kerak, chunki ular sizni kechasi uyg'oq tutadi.

patterns.formula: You shouldn't eat too many/much + OT because ...
patterns.exampleEn: You shouldn't eat too many biscuits because they are bad for your teeth.
patterns.exampleUz: Juda ko'p pechenye yemasligingiz kerak, chunki ular tishingiz uchun zararli.

patterns.formula: You should eat/drink a lot of + OT because ...
patterns.exampleEn: You should drink a lot of water because it keeps your body healthy.
patterns.exampleUz: Ko'p suv ichishingiz kerak, chunki u tanangizni sog'lom saqlaydi.
